import datetime
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BASE = ROOT / 'target/structure-review/tasks'
SOURCE = ROOT / 'target/task-search/sources'
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
def stamp():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

command, trial = sys.argv[1:3]
directory = BASE / trial
record_path = directory / 'record.json'
if command == 'init':
    if directory.exists(): raise RuntimeError('trial already exists')
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT/'tools/morph-compare/real_corpus/sources.json').read_text())
    files = []
    for source in manifest['sources']:
        for file in source['files']:
            rel = Path(source['id']) / file['path']
            data = (SOURCE/rel).read_bytes()
            assert sha(data) == file['sha256']
            dest = directory/'input'/rel
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(data)
            files.append({'path':str(rel),'sha256':sha(data)})
    save(record_path, {'trial':trial,'started_at':stamp(),'inputs':files,'events':[]})
elif command == 'run':
    kind = sys.argv[3]
    argv = sys.argv[4:]
    record = json.loads(record_path.read_text())
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    process = subprocess.run(argv,cwd=directory/'input',capture_output=True,timeout=120)
    event = {'kind':kind,'argv':argv,'at':stamp(),'elapsed_ms':(time.perf_counter_ns()-started)/1e6,'exit_code':process.returncode,'stdout':process.stdout.decode(),'stderr':process.stderr.decode(),'stdout_bytes':len(process.stdout),'stderr_bytes':len(process.stderr)}
    record['events'].append(event)
    save(record_path,record)
    print(json.dumps(event,ensure_ascii=False))
elif command == 'finish':
    record=json.loads(record_path.read_text())
    patches=[]
    for file in record['inputs']:
        rel=file['path']
        old=(SOURCE/rel).read_text()
        new=(directory/'input'/rel).read_text()
        if old==new: continue
        assert old.split('#[cfg(test)]')[-1]==new.split('#[cfg(test)]')[-1] if '#[cfg(test)]' in old else True
        patches.append({'path':rel,'sha256':sha(new.encode()),'diff':''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True),new.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='a/'+rel,tofile='b/'+rel))})
    record['patches']=patches
    record['finished_at']=stamp()
    assert patches
    save(record_path,record)
    print(json.dumps({'trial':trial,'patches':patches},ensure_ascii=False))
